notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata collection covers title and description, but not favicon or preview image.
REF-BM-04: Title, description, tags, and note are editable, but the bookmark URL is not.
REF-BM-05: No bookmark deletion operation or UI is implemented.
REF-BM-07: Cards show title, description, tags, and a generated domain initial, but no fetched favicon.
REF-BM-14: Search does not parse #tag syntax or include assigned tags in its text index.
REF-BM-15: Search is a plain substring match with no boolean operators or parenthesised groups.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not parsed; quote characters are treated literally.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action implementation.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-22: Results are always ordered newest-first; no selectable sort key is provided.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and rendered as sanitized rich HTML, but Markdown input/rendering is not implemented.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF preservation exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot integration exists.
REF-BM-26: No archive state or archive action exists.
REF-BM-27: Archive-versus-delete behavior is not implemented.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks list exists.
REF-BM-29: No saved-filter bundle entity or workflow exists.
REF-BM-30: No Netscape HTML import exists.
REF-BM-31: No Netscape HTML export exists.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings are implemented.
